title: Figure 62: normalized radar cross section vs theta, 10 m dielectric-coated sphere, 300 MHz
description: ANSYS plot titled 'Normalized Radar Cross Section, No Polarization' showing RCS/lambda^2 in dB versus theta (0-180 degrees) for a half-symmetry 10 m metallic sphere with a 1 m dielectric coating at 300 MHz and 25 elements per wavelength. Curve dips near -9 dB around 90 degrees. BAASS electromagnetic RCS capability demonstration.
